title: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration
question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group (ordered by instance UUID), and also include the maximum memory (MB) and launched-at timestamp for matching display-name groups where the instance was launched in 2014 and the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    m.status AS migration_status,
    m.source_compute,
    m.dest_compute,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.launched_at
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
    AND YEAR(i.launched_at) = 2014
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    b.instance_uuid,
    b.display_name,
    b.vm_state,
    b.migration_status,
    b.source_compute,
    b.dest_compute,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.migration_status ORDER BY b.instance_uuid) AS row_number,
    MAX(b.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY b.display_name) AS max_memory_mb,
    MAX(b.launched_at) OVER (PARTITION BY b.display_name) AS launched_at
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  instance_uuid,
  display_name,
  vm_state,
  migration_status,
  source_compute,
  dest_compute,
  row_number,
  max_memory_mb,
  launched_at
FROM agg
WHERE max_memory_mb > 16000
ORDER BY instance_uuid;

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC

WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem WITH q1 AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), q2 AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC

WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST

WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME
